content:
If you like the new wallpapers Apple designed for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't have to buy a new iPhone to use them. You can download them right here.

Download the new iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers

Although the default iOS wallpapers are dynamic and change based on your phone's movement and operation, the version below is a static image directly captured from the first iOS 27 Release Candidate.

It seems the Release Candidate didn't include the iPhone Duo wallpapers, so you'll have to wait a few more weeks, possibly until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap or click on the images to save the full-resolution wallpapers. If you're using an iOS device, you can set them as your background through the Photos app or the Settings app.

For 9to5Mac's full coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, click this link.
